spec.description: What each bhyve guest costs its host, measured from the host: CPU time, preemptions, resident memory, zvol I/O, and tap traffic, from the bhyve-guest-metrics textfile collector and node_exporter.
bhyve guest processes on the host now.
spec.title: Running guests

spec.expr: sum(bhyve_guest_config_vcpus * on (guest) group_left bhyve_guest_up) / count(node_cpu_seconds_total{instance="soundwave.sleem.net", job="node", mode="idle"})

spec.description: vCPUs configured for the running guests divided by the host's logical CPUs. Above 1 the guests can ask for more CPU than exists; whether they do shows in the CPU and preemption panels.
spec.title: vCPU overcommit

spec.description: Host CPU time all guest processes used, in cores, over the rate interval.
spec.title: Host cores used by guests

spec.description: Resident memory of all guest processes as a share of the host's physical memory. The ZFS ARC and the host's own services share the rest.
spec.title: Guest memory resident

spec.description: Whether the collector's last run read ps, ifconfig and the ZFS kstats.
spec.title: Collector

spec.description: Seconds since the collector last wrote its metrics; it runs every minute from cron.
spec.title: Collector age

spec.description: Host CPU time each guest process used, in cores: vCPU threads plus bhyve's device emulation.
spec.title: Host CPU per guest

spec.description: Host CPU time per guest divided by its configured vCPUs. Near 100% the guest is using every vCPU it has.
spec.title: CPU use of configured vCPUs

spec.description: Involuntary context switches of each guest process per second: how often its threads were taken off a host CPU for other work.
spec.title: Preemptions per guest

spec.description: Preemptions divided by host CPU time used: a contention indicator that does not grow just because a guest is busy. A guest that climbs here while its CPU use is flat is competing for host CPUs.
spec.title: Preemptions per CPU second

spec.description: Resident memory of each guest process.
spec.title: Resident memory per guest

spec.description: Resident memory of each guest process divided by the memory configured for it. Guests touch their memory over time and bhyve does not return it to the host, so long-running guests approach 100%.
spec.title: Resident share of configured memory

spec.description: Bytes read per second from each guest's zvols, from the ZFS per-dataset counters.
spec.title: Disk read per guest

spec.description: Bytes written per second to each guest's zvols.
spec.title: Disk write per guest

spec.description: Read and write operations per second on each guest's zvols.
spec.title: Disk operations per guest

spec.expr: sum by (guest) (rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{instance="soundwave.sleem.net", job="node", device=~"tap.+"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (device) group_left (guest) bhyve_guest_tap_info)

spec.description: Bytes per second the host sent into each guest's tap interfaces, all switches together.
spec.title: Network: guest receive

spec.expr: sum by (guest) (rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{instance="soundwave.sleem.net", job="node", device=~"tap.+"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (device) group_left (guest) bhyve_guest_tap_info)

spec.description: Bytes per second each guest sent out through its tap interfaces, all switches together.
spec.title: Network: guest transmit

spec.description: Configured size and current use of each running guest.
spec.title: Guests

spec.description: Each guest zvol with its vm-bhyve disk slot and current throughput.
spec.title: Zvols
bhyve Guests
